yt_title: 156 saved reels. Guess how many were worth doing
caption:
156 saved reels. Guess how many were worth doing. Comment your guess before you watch to the end.

SaveSort read every one and split them into:
• Worth doing
• Needs the video
• Be careful
• Gated guides

How: download your Instagram data (Settings → Accounts Center → Your information and permissions → Export your information), tick only Saved, then drop the zip into SaveSort.

Free, runs in your browser, nothing uploaded.

#savedreels #instagramtips #productivity #organization #lifehacks
